components.name: GlassSurface
components.summary: The Liquid Glass material: a translucent, blurred, saturated layer with a light-catching rim and a top-left specular sheen; every GD Liquid Glass component is made of it.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Capsule buttons in Fira Sans Bold UPPERCASE, the shape of the Grid Dynamics website CTAs.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A glass container with an optional eyebrow, title, body and footer row.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: App-level navigation in a floating glass panel, expanded with icons and labels or collapsed to an icon rail.

components.name: TopBar
components.summary: The app's top-right control cluster: project switcher, New project button and the user menu, in one floating glass capsule.

components.name: NavBar
components.summary: A floating glass capsule for top-level navigation: GD logo left, links centre, one primary action right.

components.name: TabBar
components.summary: A floating glass capsule of 2–5 section tabs for mobile and compact app layouts; the selected tab sits in a yellow-tinted glass lens.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A dropdown of actions or choices anchored to a trigger, on thick glass.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: A centred dialog of thick glass for focused tasks: creating a project, answering a decision, confirming something irreversible.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: Switches between 2–5 views of the same content; a glass lens slides to the chosen segment with a slight overshoot.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A dropdown for picking one value, usually a filter (Domain, Owner, Status).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on/off toggle: a glass thumb on a clear track that fills `yellow` when on; the thumb stretches while pressed.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labelled single-line input on `glass-fill-strong` with an inset shadow, so typed text always meets contrast over imagery.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: A capsule search input with a magnifier and a clear button.

components.name: PeoplePicker
components.summary: Adds people to something (project contributors, decision assignees) by typing a name, email or role and picking from suggestions; picks become removable chips.

components.name: LinkField
components.summary: A URL input with a **Test access** button and a live status line, for connecting repositories, drives and other sources.

components.name: OptionCards
components.summary: Large single-choice answers: lettered options (A, B, C) with an optional free-text "Other" (D), or a Yes/No pair.

components.name: Dropzone
components.summary: A dashed glass area for adding files by drag-and-drop or the system file picker.

components.name: FileRow
components.summary: One file in an upload list: type icon, name, size, and its state.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: A thin progress track with a yellow fill, plus `Spinner` for short unknown waits.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Pill labels for categories and statuses: the only shape the GD deck system has always rounded.

components.name: SeverityBadge
components.summary: Severity of a decision or risk: Critical, High, Medium, Low, shown as a four-step bar glyph plus the word.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person (initials or photo) or the SpecBot assistant, in a small glass circle.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: A big-number tile: Fira Sans ExtraBold numeral (`stat` style), a half-size unit, and a muted label, with a short yellow bar above.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: A centred glass card that explains why a screen is empty and offers the next step.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Placeholder shapes that shimmer while content loads.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short glass label that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: A short confirmation or error that appears bottom-right and fades after ~4 s.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: A modal panel of thick glass rising from the bottom (mobile) or centred (desktop) over a `scrim`, for focused tasks and confirmations.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Small UI glyphs drawn from Phosphor Icons (Regular weight, MIT licence): a flagged substitute, since the GD brand has no interface icon set of its own.

components.name: Prose
components.summary: Styles for rendered Markdown: README views, spec files, linked documents in decisions.

components.name: FileTree
components.summary: A folder tree of project files with expand/collapse, file-type icons and a selected file.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.summary: The path to the current file or page, with each earlier step clickable.

components.name: SelectionToolbar
components.summary: A floating glass toolbar that appears above selected text in a document: **Edit**, **Comment**, **Ask SpecBot**.

components.name: CommentThread
components.summary: A comment thread anchored to highlighted text, with @mentions for people and @specbot.

components.name: DecisionList
components.summary: The decisions inbox: a glass table of decisions with domain, severity and assignee; each row opens the decision.

components.name: QuestionBlock
components.summary: One question inside a decision: numbered heading, optional help, an answer input and an optional comment.

components.name: DocLinks
components.summary: Links to the source documents behind a decision or an answer, opening the Markdown version in the Files view.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.summary: Messages in the SpecBot conversation: user bubbles on the right, assistant answers on the left with tool steps and source citations.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.summary: The "Ask me" input for SpecBot: a large glass capsule with a yellow-glass send button and optional suggested prompts above it.

components.name: ConnectorCard
components.summary: A marketplace tile for a connector: vendor logo, name, category, one-line description, status and action.

components.name: DiagramNode
components.summary: One box on an architecture diagram: a glass card with a tinted icon tile, an UPPERCASE kind label, a title and a technology subtitle.

components.name: ArchitectureDiagram
components.summary: A data-driven architecture diagram: nodes, boundary groups and routed connectors on a dotted glass canvas, with a legend and click-to-trace selection.

components.name: ProcessFlow
components.summary: A swimlane process diagram laid out from data: lanes for who does the work, columns for sequence, and typed steps joined by flow connectors.

components.name: FlowCanvas
components.summary: React Flow (`@xyflow/react` 12) wired to the GD diagram look: GD node types, connector styles, markers, legend, dotted canvas, styled controls and minimap, and click-to-trace.
